title: Information Disclosure in Application Configuration Endpoint
description: The /rest/admin/application-configuration endpoint exposes sensitive configuration information without proper authentication. This includes Google OAuth client IDs, server configuration details, product information, and other sensitive application settings.
impact: An attacker can access sensitive configuration data including OAuth credentials, server details, and application internals. This information can be used to craft further attacks against the application.
remediation: Implement proper authentication and access controls on administrative endpoints. Ensure sensitive configuration data is not exposed to unauthenticated users.
